goal:
Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/AccountPage.ts

This is a Playwright Page Object for the account control in the navbar. The _Layout.cshtml has:
- Account control div with id="account-control" (role="button")
- Account name span with class="account-name" showing User.Identity.Name
- Account dropdown with id="account-dropdown" containing "View Profile" and "Settings" links
- Chevron icon
- The account control is only visible when authenticated

The file should:
- Extend BasePage from '../BasePage'
- Export an AccountPage class
- Have locators: accountControl (#account-control), accountName (.account-name), accountDropdown (#account-dropdown), profileLink (role link "View Profile"), settingsLink (role link "Settings")
- Have methods: getAccountName() returning text, clickAccountDropdown(), isAccountVisible() checking if account control exists
- Import { Page, Locator } from '@playwright/test'
